transcribed_question:
a) IDENTIFY THE PINNED STRUCTURE BLUE?
b) IDENTIFY THE PINNED STRUCTURE GREEN
c) EMBRYONIC ORIGIN OF THE STRUCTURE PINNED STRUCTURE BLUE?

marker.description: Blue-headed pin inserted into the renal pelvis region

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the blue pin.
main_explanation: The blue pin is inserted into the central, funnel-shaped expansion of the ureter located in the renal hilum, which is the renal pelvis.

supporting_question.question: What is the embryological origin of the structure indicated by the blue pin?
supporting_question.explanation: The renal pelvis, calyces, and ureter are derived from the ureteric bud, which is an outgrowth of the mesonephric (Wolffian) duct.
